note: EVERY PERSON IN THIS FILE IS INVENTED. The roster is what decides who the product tracks, so it does not carry a real name until the Israeli defamation-law review (issue #28) has landed and the real roster has been reviewed against it. Adding a person here is a reviewed change: state in `qualifies` what put them in the public eye, in the capacity we are tracking them in, and in `coverage` which sources reach them and from when. We do not track private people or personal activity.
